lines: Faculty of Science - Computer Science (Computer Science Program)

1.0 course from: Computer Science courses at the 3000-level or above; courses at the 2100 level or above in Applied Mathematics, Calculus, Mathematics, Statistical Sciences; courses numbered 2200 or above in Writing; Applied Mathematics 2402A, Philosophy 2720F/G.
